# iwrzwr visual archive (vendored)

Original study pages from [kaganin/iwrzwr-visual-archive](https://github.com/kaganin/iwrzwr-visual-archive) by Kagan Yaldizkaya.

MIT License. Copyright (c) 2026 Kagan Yaldizkaya. See `LICENSE`.

These files are the archive's built study pages, kept as published. They are served only by the development route `/dev/iwrzwr-archive/…` and are not imported by production pages.

`catalog.json` lists each sketch, the category heading used in the dev switcher, and the study file plus `?item=` index the archive uses to show that one sketch.
